description: Defines the TargetHistogram class and related structures for managing histograms of target values with fractional counts, used in media learning components.

classes.name: TargetHistogram
classes.description: A histogram class that stores counts of target values, allowing fractional counts, with methods for normalization, aggregation, and analysis.
